pain_points: Manual, repetitive marketing tasks drain team bandwidth
Fragmented customer data across CRM, email, web analytics
No centralized lead scoring or qualification process
Limited budget for enterprise software—need cost-effective solutions
High customer churn due to poor customer experience
Can't respond quickly to customer inquiries
Scaling operations without hiring big teams
decision_factors: Total cost of ownership (licensing + implementation + training)
Ease of integration with existing systems

marketing_automation.problem: Marketing team manually manages email campaigns, social, web events—no workflow automation
symptoms: Email list unmanaged; low open/click rates
Leads sit in inbox instead of flowing through qualification process
Same manual outreach repeated every month
marketing_automation.job_to_be_done: Automate lead capture → scoring → nurture → handoff to sales with measurable results
value_delivered: 20-40% increase in qualified leads per month

data_pipelines.problem: Customer and business data lives in silos—CRM, email, web analytics, sales tools don't talk
symptoms: Reports created manually in Excel from multiple sources
Single source of truth doesn't exist
Delays in decision-making due to stale data
Customer 360 view impossible—team doesn't know full customer journey
data_pipelines.job_to_be_done: Unify all data sources → clean & enrich → accessible dashboard for operations, marketing, sales
value_delivered: Unified customer view across all touchpoints
Better customer segmentation for targeted campaigns

ai_chatbot.problem: Customer support team overwhelmed with repetitive questions; long response times hurt satisfaction
symptoms: High response time (6-24 hours) to common questions
ai_chatbot.job_to_be_done: Deploy AI chatbot to handle 60-80% of FAQ, routine inquiries, and escalate complex issues to humans smartly
value_delivered: Response time reduced from hours to seconds
Support team freed up for complex issues and strategy

english_keywords_korean_context: Marketing operations tool for growing companies
marketing_automation.search_intent: Looking for tools or agencies to automate their marketing workflows

data_pipelines.search_intent: Looking for data infrastructure help or outsourced data engineering

ai_chatbot.search_intent: Looking for chatbot builders or AI customer service solutions

top_industries_to_target.why: High customer volume, constant marketing/support needs, strong ROI case for automation
Data-driven mindset, quick to adopt automation, viral growth potential from SDR automation
Rapid scaling, compliance-conscious (data pipelines), high customer lifetime value
Agencies need automation for clients, re-sellable services, consistent revenue

outbound_channels: Naver / Korean tech forums (where Korean SMBs research tools)
Direct cold outreach via corporate directories
